coverage: Read the whole sheet once for layout, then each half once against C: handwritten date; salutation; opening reference; S.G.A reference and first four correction rows; second-group heading and three correction rows; underlined marginal note and its vertical grouping stroke; all five lines of the final paragraph including the altered n°; closing, signature and archive numeral 8. Checked every typed word, accent, punctuation mark, all seven page/line references, handwritten numerals, mathematical letters, primes, indices and inserted symbols. Five unresolved loci each received one documented tight crop, each viewed once. No part of the source remains unviewed. H is descriptive only and has no collation rows.

changes.locus: Left marginal note, second underlined word
changes.evidence: Rotated crop shows capital M, e, two short s forms, dotted i, n and final descending looped g. The word is sufficiently legible to remove C's uncertainty. The first line reads demander; no separate à is visible.

changes.locus: Vertical grouping stroke to the right of the left marginal note, beside final paragraph
changes.evidence: Whole image, halves and crop locate the near-vertical stroke at x about 325, beside the final paragraph, immediately right of the marginal words. C's separate figure places the stroke centrally in the reading; the revised figure keeps it in the left margin with its relative relation to the note.

c_doubts.locus: Correction 2, symbol between s and Hom
c_doubts.evidence: The enlarged glyph has a curled upper termination, a middle cross stroke and lower rounded curve. These support epsilon-like and membership-like readings without settling the intended symbol. The mathematical position suggests membership but does not determine the ink. The faint detached dots to the right of the formula do not have the size or regular baseline position of the typed periods.
The rotated crop separates M-e-s-s-i-n-g, including the dot over i and the looped g descender; both marginal words are underlined.

A raised loop and crowded lower hook are visible. The crop does not establish whether the lower dark matter is a deleted question mark or part of the handwritten correction/loop. The uncertainty concerns underlying text and correction state, not the visible raised o.

The first upright descends into a long flourish and has a small detached dash/dot to its right. The next tall stroke and connected low flourish permit C's tentative L/V readings but do not justify identifying or expanding the initials.
Half a shows final t followed by a clear interword gap before j'ai; there is no final s.
Half a shows adjacent d-o-ù, with the grave accent over u and no apostrophe after d. The apostrophe in the following l'assertion is separately visible.

c_doubts.locus: Final paragraph, agreement in notes ... envoyés
c_doubts.evidence: Both halves show é followed immediately by final s; no intervening e is present.

c_doubts.evidence: Half a shows the opening pair of typed quote strokes before le and no closing pair after de.
